claims.object_text: hub-protein among shared differentially expressed genes in delirium and AD identified by PPI network analysis
claims.quote: Among the sDEGs of delirium and AD, the top 10 hub-proteins including ALB, APP, BDNF, CREB1, DLG4, GAD1, GAD2, GFAP, GRIN2B and GRIN2A were found by the PPI network analysis.
